# Docset reader

`package.lisp` and `docset.lisp` are copied unchanged from the sibling `docset`
project at commit `481f57e7222925c3157e41a7e3deaeb628ecc9a7`.
The MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`. This dependency is loaded by the
`kryptonedit/docset` ASDF system and works without wxLambda.

The Common Lisp data in `data/docsets/common-lisp/` is copied from Cadre
(`lisp-edit`) at commit `bd5f6f45fd99ebf7a26a905ecdb6ec3e9ee3d3f4`.
Its manifest retains the dpANS3 version, source, attribution, and license.
The data is rendered locally; it is not the LispWorks HyperSpec website.
